newsitem.title: UK: NWE gas oil spreads steady as screen strengthens.
newsitem.headline: NWE gas oil spreads steady as screen strengthens.

text.p: European gas oil differentials were steady on Tuesday, with interest from buyers still evident despite dollar strength versus the mark and a robust screen, traders said.
IPE July gas oil rose $1.50 a tonne to $166.75 on an initial surge led by short-covering following Monday's gains.
Two barges of 0.2 percent heating oil were moved early on at the outright numbers of $167 and $166.75, equivalent at that stage to flat and 25 cents above the front month screen.
Other traders assessed prompt Rotterdam refinery material at 50 cents over the front month, the level at which at least one 1,000 tonne barge moved basis Antwerp.
"At 75 cents over we have no customers, at 50 cents over a few customers and at flat lots of customers," one seller said.

German demand has been muted by the dollar hovering at 40-month highs against the mark and boosting buyers' costs. But cooler weather has helped demand, which combined with a thinner supply of Russian barrels has helped to support premiums.
Low sulphur diesel cargoes were steady at $6 offered and $5 bid over the July contract. Low sulphur diesel cargoes were valued at around July IPE +$6/$7 cif Rotterdam.
